{{Top|leg}}
A '''spice-breather apparatus''' was a device that native and long-term residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]] required to breathe on other planets due to their tolerance and dependence on the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that permeated the world's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Without the apparatus, [[Sevari]] could succumb to [[spice narcosis]].{{Stub}}
